inputs.text: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan has firmly rejected those allegations of Rs 700 crore corruption tied to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, insisting the claims are politically driven. From my view this is just another calculated smear from forces invested in preserving economic inequality, aimed at derailing any institutional reforms that might empower cooperatives to better support workers, small producers, and marginalized communities against exploitation. These attacks distract from the real need to strengthen public systems that challenge entrenched power rather than letting the privileged sabotage progress for the vulnerable.
